summary: Addex Therapeutics Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, furnishing a press release of full-year 2025 financial results and a corporate update. The press release describes continued pipeline development for GABAB PAM and dipraglurant, an option/collaboration agreement with Sinntaxis for an mGlu5 NAM license, regained rights to ADX71149, and a strategic investment in Stalicla SA. The disclosure is a routine business update of operational progress and financial results, not an event-driven special situation. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisor names are provided. The cash position of CHF 1.6 million is noted. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report with no special-situation trigger.
